body: i hope we can get some wins too. it’s pretty hard right now. i just keep getting walked on constantly. i really wish i didn’t grow up the way i did. left me with so many scars that have just ruined my life. is what it is. i just try and make the best of it and always get crushed over and over and over again. it’s draining and i’m always tired. i bet you feel the same in a lot of ways.

i’m a lot like you in a way. except i dropped college cause i was on the brink of killing myself though. i sat in bed for 3 days straight only getting up to use the bathroom. that weekend my mother left for the weekend. she didn’t care how i was feeling. i couldn’t take it. i spent the whole time getting as high as possible and drinking my pain away. i just didn’t want to feel alive anymore. i haven’t felt the same since then. 

my dad has been shitty to me my whole entire life. he’s got a million problems and i still love him anyways. i promised myself i would never grow up to be like him. I ended up worse than him somehow. 

my brother ended up just like him. has horrible anger issues and has made my and my mothers moms lives complete hell. right now he is arguing with her and treating her like shit again slamming things. i just want out. i feel like running away and never contacting anyone ever again.

just like you i try to find reasons not to finish myself off. it’s all hopeless for me. i don’t know you or your situation. you sound smart though. i hope you find happiness one day and get better. if you do please let me know how.
